name: dawsbot-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by @dawsbot: cross-model review tooling and code-style guidance for agent-navigable codebases.

plugins.name: codex-opinion
plugins.description: Get a genuinely independent second opinion from Codex (OpenAI's CLI agent) on work Claude just produced. Blind-frames the artifacts so Codex judges on merits instead of agreeing with a confident summary.

plugins.name: grok-opinion
plugins.description: Get a genuinely independent second opinion from Grok (xAI's CLI agent) on work Claude just produced. Blind-frames the artifacts so Grok judges on merits instead of agreeing with a confident summary.

plugins.name: discoverable-code
plugins.description: Code style rules for a codebase that coding agents can actually navigate. Agents retrieve code by grep, not by semantic analysis, so names and paths are addresses — this skill covers the three-word naming threshold, branded ID types, comments at definitions, and conventions files.
